description: Defines the rx::VertexArray11 class implementing rx::VertexArrayImpl for Direct3D 11 rendering in ANGLE project.

classes.name: VertexArray11
classes.description: Implements vertex array functionality for Direct3D 11 in ANGLE, managing attribute storage, state synchronization, and index data caching.

methods.name: VertexArray11
methods.description: Constructor initializing the vertex array with given state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the vertex array.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the vertex array state with the context, without applying updates.

methods.name: syncStateForDraw
methods.description: Updates buffer pointers for drawing operations.

methods.name: hasActiveDynamicAttrib
methods.description: Checks if there are active dynamic attributes.

methods.name: getCurrentStateSerial
methods.description: Returns the current state serial number.

methods.name: markAllAttributeDivisorsForAdjustment
methods.description: Adjusts attribute divisors for multi-view program changes.

methods.name: isCachedIndexInfoValid
methods.description: Checks if cached index info is valid.

methods.name: getCachedDestinationIndexType
methods.description: Returns the cached index type for drawing.

methods.name: updateVertexAttribStorage
methods.description: Updates storage for a specific vertex attribute.
